radiusJustification: 500 feet (~152 m). The buyer question is whether a well is ON or NEAR the property for use/value impact — not whether a centroid falls inside the polygon. Strict PIP misses pad-edge and shared-boundary wells. 500 ft is the common Texas surface-impact desktop screening distance for O&G proximity to structures: captures adjacent-lot pads without quarter-mile false positives. The radius is carried in every atom body (including absences) so the claim is legible.
